title: Puttering Pebble Puffer
statement: An ink-speckled, apricot-sized puffer uses little jets of water to arrange white pebbles into increasingly elaborate spirals, then hovers over each new gap as though surprised it leads somewhere. Its tank is a quiet workshop of blue slate, rippled sand, and amber light, with one gloriously crooked pebble that it keeps trying—and failing—to balance.
